links.outcome: Whether traditional metrics and benchmarks reflect clinical utility of LLM responses to pharmacology scenarios
links.effect: BLEU 0.003–0.024 and ROUGE-L 0.079–0.166 failed to reflect clinical utility; CVD framework exposed efficiency–safety trade-offs; GPT-4o safety 0.437 (moderate).
links.quote: Traditional metrics (BLEU: 0.003–0.024; ROUGE-L: 0.079–0.166) failed to reflect clinical utility, while the CVD framework exposed critical efficiency–safety trade-offs.

unlisted_practices: Composite Clinical Value Density metric balancing efficiency and safety for LLM evaluation

screen.reason: The paper benchmarks multiple LLMs on 60 clinical pharmacology scenarios against pharmacist outputs using a novel evaluation metric (Clinical Value Density). It assesses model performance, safety, and efficiency trade-offs, but does not test an organizational deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
